title: Seller Ops Copilot
description: An AI-powered seller insights app that answers plain-English business questions using tool-calling and schema-validated outputs so recommendations stay data-grounded.
features: Natural-language Q&A for sales, inventory, and staffing decisions
Typed tool-calling pipeline that computes metrics instead of generating numbers
Zod-validated structured responses with source traceability
Neighborhood-context toggle for weather, events, and sentiment overlays
Saved insights flow and a dedicated technical documentation site

title: Ads Integration Workbench (Android)
description: A production-style Android workbench for testing and debugging ad network integrations with plugin-driven architecture, observability, and local telemetry analysis.
features: Plugin-based integration model for Mock, AdMob, Unity Ads, and AppLovin MAX
Debug console with event timeline, filtering, and deep event inspection
Exportable debug bundle with automatic credential redaction
Issue reproduction harness with timeout guards and failure injection toggles
Insights view for success rates, latency percentiles, and top error patterns

title: Dino Runner Kotlin
description: A Chrome Dino-style endless runner built with a deterministic, testable game engine and clean Android architecture for reliable gameplay and strong engineering quality.
features: Pure Kotlin core game engine with no Android imports for high testability
Deterministic behavior using seeded random sources for reproducible tests
MVVM architecture with clear UI, domain, and data separation
Quality gates via unit tests, ktlint, detekt, and GitHub Actions
Gameplay systems including progressive speed, collisions, pause, and high-score persistence

title: Personal Resume Website (Eleventy)
description: A content-driven personal site built on Eleventy with reusable Nunjucks layouts, structured data files, and Netlify deployment.
features: Layout inheritance with shared base templates for maintainability
Data-driven sections sourced from structured JSON files
Blog system with date formatting, tags, and feed support
Standalone docs and content pages integrated into the same build pipeline
Netlify deployment workflow with static build output

title: Image AI Detector (Chrome Extension)
description: A Chrome extension that analyzes images on web pages to detect whether they are AI-generated or real, providing confidence scores for each classification.
features: One-click analysis from browser popup
Real-time image classification with confidence scores
Visual overlays on detected images
Local Flask server integration with Hugging Face models
Graceful timeout handling for network issues
Easy setup for non-technical users
